description: Use this when someone asks how much safety stock to hold or at what stock level to reorder a product. Give a daily demand history (best) or an average daily demand with its variability, plus the supplier lead time and a service level. Returns safety stock, lead-time demand and the reorder point with Forthcast's formula and assumptions. Works without a connected store.

average_daily_demand.description: Average units sold per day, if no daily history.
average_daily_demand.title: Average Daily Demand

daily_demand.description: Daily units sold, oldest first, 14 to 365 values.
daily_demand.title: Daily Demand

demand_std_daily.description: Standard deviation of daily demand; assumed sqrt(average) when omitted.
demand_std_daily.title: Demand Std Daily

service_level.description: Target in-stock probability, 0.50 to 0.99 (95 also accepted).
service_level.title: Service Level

name: calculate_reorder_point
